description: Dataset-specific known channel ordering (EEG only). Use when .mat files do not contain channel names. Order must match the channel dimension of the data array.
notes: Replace with your dataset's actual channel order (e.g. 22ch or 64ch cap).
Channel names should be 10-20 style for cross-dataset alignment.
Do not include EOG/EMG/other non-EEG channels here if you want merge by common EEG only.
